title.value: Find a London flat to rent

introduction.value: The poster used Claude Cowork to search for and find a flat to rent in London in five days.

method.value: The poster had Claude Cowork run a repeat search across SpareRoom, OpenRent, Rightmove, and Zoopla twice a day. It screened out student flats and homes with three or more bedrooms, drafted personalised outreach for promising listings, and emailed the poster a digest they could act on from their phone.

outcome.value: The poster says this process found them a London rental in five days. The source does not give harder numbers on viewings, replies, or which part of the process still needed manual handling.

notes.value: The key catch is that the setup relied on Claude Cowork repeatedly scanning multiple rental sites and sending digest emails on a schedule.

source_text.body:
Find a London flat to rent
The poster used Claude Cowork to search for and find a flat to rent in London in five days.
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The poster had Claude Cowork run a repeat search across SpareRoom, OpenRent, Rightmove, and Zoopla twice a day. It screened out student flats and homes with three or more bedrooms, drafted personalised outreach for promising listings, and emailed the poster a digest they could act on from their phone.
How it went
The poster says this process found them a London rental in five days. The source does not give harder numbers on viewings, replies, or which part of the process still needed manual handling.
Worth knowing
The key catch is that the setup relied on Claude Cowork repeatedly scanning multiple rental sites and sending digest emails on a schedule.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Help me find a flat to rent in [city/area] with a budget of [monthly rent], [number] bedrooms, move-in around [date], and these must-haves: [list]. Search listing sites, build a shortlist in a spreadsheet with price, location, commute to [workplace], and links, and draft inquiry messages for the top picks. Show me the drafts before sending any message or filling any form.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1smay7l/claude_cowork_found_me_a_flat_to_rent_in_london
